setting: A land of hills, woods, rivers and a lake, where two small towns stand half a day's walk apart. Deer graze the open land and wolves roam the woods. Seasons turn quickly; in winter nothing grows, nights are colder, and food that is not cooked or stored spoils. People live about seventy years here, but the years pass very fast.

towns.name: Eastmere
towns.character: a lakeside town of fishers and cooks; wood is plentiful, stone scarce

towns.name: Stonewatch
towns.character: a hill town of hunters and masons; stone is plentiful, fish scarce
